name: razent-commerce-mcp
description: Official Razent Quick Commerce Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for 10-15 minute grocery & essentials delivery.

tools.name: ap2_execute_autonomous_checkout
tools.description: Execute autonomous Human-Not-Present purchase under Google AP2 protocol with real Razorpay test settlement. Verifies delegated spending cap and creates authoritative orders.

tools.name: create_checkout_session
tools.description: Create an Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) checkout session and generate a verified Razorpay payment link. Human-in-the-loop: Present the payment link to the customer for authorization. Never charge automatically.

tools.name: get_checkout_session
tools.description: Check live payment and order settlement status of a checkout session. Polls Razorpay in real time: when customer completes payment, automatically settles the order and generates tracking and invoice links.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search products in Razent 10-15 min quick grocery delivery catalog via Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP). Features typo tolerance, category filtering, plural stemming, and price ceilings. Returns matching items with price in rupees, stock, and images.

tools.name: track_orders
tools.description: Track live order delivery and history by Order ID (e.g. RAZ-A2A-MTY6O735), customer mobile phone, or email. Returns delivery timeline stage, items, address, and downloadable tax invoice link.
